title: ENGLISH MADE FUR FELT EQUESTRI...
reason: Fur-felt hat with a clear Lincoln Bennett & Co Piccadilly label and royal arms (maker not named in the title), in good order, plus riding gloves.
findings: Three photos: the lot, the hat on a stand and the label inside the crown. A dark charcoal to black low-crowned fur-felt hat (short topper or riding hat shape) with a ribbed silk band, a side bow loop, a bound brim and a cream satin lining. The paper label in the crown reads 'LINCOLN BENNETT & Co. HATTERS PICCADILLY LONDON' in gold on a blue shield beside a red and gold royal arms, so the hat is by a well known London court hatter (the title says only 'English made'). No size mark or date visible. Gloves in a wicker basket: a pair of tan suede or pigskin gloves, two string-back (crochet back) gloves with brown leather trim, a yellow suede pair in a clear packet with press studs, and a clear bag holding more brown and tan leather gloves; no glove brand legible. A web search (19/10/2026) describes Lincoln Bennett as a Piccadilly hatter with royal patronage (https://www.campaignfurniture.com/artists/lincoln-bennett).
condition: Hat looks clean and well kept with an even nap, a few lighter fibres and light dust, no crushing or brim damage seen; lining and label slightly toned with small spotting at the lower edge of the label; band intact. The loose gloves show wear, some pairs are still bagged.
rescore_note: Clear Lincoln Bennett & Co Piccadilly label with royal arms on a clean fur-felt hat is a real maker plus, but there is no size or box, top hats are plentiful and the gloves are unbranded; about $80 to $120 for the lot, bottom of the $80 to $200 band. Estimate only, no comparable sales checked (search budget used up).
